name: Welcome!
summary: This quest greets newly arrived adventurers in Teldrassil carrying a special Dolanaar Gift Voucher. By bringing the token to Orenthil Whisperwind in the village of Dolanaar, travelers receive a rare companion to accompany them on their journeys across Azeroth.

sections.title: A Welcoming Gift in Dolanaar
sections.body: Young night elves venturing south from Shadowglen soon come across the tree-shaded settlement of Dolanaar. Among its residents stands Orenthil Whisperwind, an attendant ready to greet select newcomers. Those carrying a Dolanaar Gift Voucher are directed straight to Orenthil, who eagerly exchanges the parchment for a curious, loyal companion pet.

sections.title: An Honored Arrival
sections.body: While most initiates must earn every scrap of equipment and companionship through trials against corruption in the boughs of Teldrassil, this voucher marks the bearer as a celebrated arrival. Orenthil welcomes the adventurer to Azeroth, bestowing a unique creature to follow them through wilderness, barrow dens, and beyond.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i have this voucher
faq.answer: The quest directs holders of a special voucher to Orenthil Whisperwind in Dolanaar. Handing over the voucher grants the adventurer a unique vanity pet to accompany them throughout their adventures.
Orenthil Whisperwind is a night elf stationed in Dolanaar within Teldrassil. He assists travelers by receiving their gift vouchers and presenting them with a companion creature.
Dolanaar is the primary village in central Teldrassil, located just south down the road from the novice grounds of Shadowglen and east of Darnassus.

faq.q: Can any adventurer take this quest?
aliases: is this quest available to everyone
faq.answer: This quest is only available to adventurers who possess the Dolanaar Gift Voucher, an exclusive parchment provided to select travelers upon entering the world.

faq.q: What kind of companions can you receive?
faq.answer: Orenthil Whisperwind offers a choice among rare and exotic creatures, giving the traveler a small animal companion to follow them across Azeroth.

faq.q: Does this quest affect your standing in Teldrassil?
aliases: is it part of a main storyline
faq.answer: No. The quest is a ceremonial welcome and does not alter the political conflicts, demonic corruption, or spider infestations threatening the boughs of Teldrassil.

angles.text: For young night elves departing Shadowglen, receiving a companion in Dolanaar provides comfort and fellowship before facing the troubled woods of Teldrassil.
The gesture marks the recipient as a celebrated arrival in Alliance territory, welcomed personally by local caretakers like Orenthil Whisperwind.
